items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: for me to include Elvis Costello’s music what I do to me is a stretch.

ctx.x: You know. I just cut a record for HighNote again. I’m happy to be with them. And it’s all very esoteric music. Babs Gonsales, an Elvis Costello tune — that’s not esoteric but for me to include Elvis Costello’s music what I do to me is a stretch. But I do a bit by Lenny Bruce that Lenny did with Steve Allen. It’s not dated. It’s so today. So that kind of stuff, I mean I want to be turned on to something different. So I hope that somebody who comes to see what I do wants to get turned on to something different.…
Hat size. I’ve got to borrow that one too. That’s great. So I know you have to get on the road. Do you have a piece of advice for aspiring singers? What should they always have?
